5334.title: Desktop server destination duplication
5334.rootCauseOneLine: The shared list builder concatenates account targets and custom URLs without destination deduplication and always offers the built-in target.
5334.proposedFix: Define Connect-versus-custom target/authentication semantics and built-in visibility before shipping a destination merge; the stopped local candidate preserves the active route.
5334.caveats: Native macOS and real-account discovery were not tested. Browser screenshot capture was unavailable; no image was manufactured. A blanket discovery limitation is refuted by current source. No PR: authentication-route and product-policy decisions are required.
